static_traits.name: Fang Siting
static_traits.social_status: Tension with hiking-loving friends (often declining invitations);Daily life affected (avoiding planning hikes and outdoor activities); has friends to talk about personal issues with but not yet discussed this negative belief specifically.
static_traits.medical_history: without similar problem history;not yet received psychotherapy;No major physical illness.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, cooperative, neutral tone; can describe experiences and thoughts concretely.

basic_info.main_problem: I have a belief: although I like hiking, I am terrible at hiking. This belief makes me feel distressed and doubt my own ability.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because negative beliefs about my hiking ability have affected my mood and prevent me from joining activities I used to enjoy.
growth_experiences: Last year, an especially difficult hiking trip (tough terrain, slippery roads) became the starting point of the negative belief: after that experience, she began persistently doubting her hiking ability, thinking she was terrible, and developed Anxiety and avoidance whenever considering or planning a hike, gradually enjoying hiking less.

special_situations.event: Starts planning a hike or merely thinking about going hiking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I might perform poorly on tough terrain, it means my overall hiking is bad; to avoid failing again, I should not go.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Canceling plans or finding excuses not to hike.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am terrible; I should stay home.

special_situations.event: Recalls last year's hiking experience with difficult terrain and a wet, slippery surface
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One bad experience is enough to prove my ability is insufficient, and it will be just as bad or worse afterwards.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding more difficult routes, or simply not hiking.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will also be bad; there may be safety problems.

special_situations.event: Being invited by friends to go hiking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly I will drag everyone down and disappoint friends, showing I am no good.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Declines invitations; reduces going out with them to avoid being evaluated.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible; better not to go.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive experiences are just luck and do not reflect real ability.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking reassurance from friends, but quickly negating positive feedback.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That was just luck; it does not count.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to keep enjoying hiking, gain confidence, and be accepted by friends
core_conflict.fear: Fears failing again and being negatively evaluated, experiencing shame and frustration
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety by avoiding hiking, protecting self-esteem and relationships

object_relations.self_representation: Inadequate hiker, prone to failure and possibly dragging others down
object_relations.object_representation: Friends who may be disappointed or criticize oneself (potential judges)

manifestations: Negative beliefs limit choices and actions, avoiding joining once-loved hiking
Hesitation and fear when planning a hike, hard to decide for oneself

positive_force: Loves hiking and is motivated to resume participation
Has had successful hiking experiences that can serve as positive evidence
Willing to try behavioral experiments and record thoughts
Has friends and some social support
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, negating the positive, and personalization
Negative core belief about hiking ability ('I am terrible at hiking')
Avoiding hiking for short-term relief, reinforcing long-term Fear and Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding hiking and related outdoor activities
antecedent: Planning or thinking about going hiking
Received a hiking invitation from a friend
Recalling a difficult hiking experience last year
Estimates the terrain or weather conditions may be difficult/slippery
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core belief about hiking ability and catastrophic predictions (fearing another failure or unsafe situations).
target_behavior.function: Avoiding Anxiety and potential failure, gaining short-term security and self-esteem maintenance.
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced participation in hiking and outdoor activities, affected mood, Relationship tension with hiking-loving friends,Decreased enjoyment of life.
